target: Replace the 8 non-existent `mcp__conport__conport_*` tool names and the 2 non-existent FTS tools (search_decisions_fts, search_custom_data_value_fts) in .claude/commands with live ConPort SSE tool names, aligning every documented argument with server.py signatures.
invariants: MACRO I01-I10 apply (MACRO_PACKET.json objective + this package).

Rename map (exact, 1:1): `mcp__conport__conport_get_context` -> `mcp__conport__get_context`; `mcp__conport__conport_get_progress` -> `mcp__conport__get_progress`; `mcp__conport__conport_log_decision` -> `mcp__conport__log_decision`; `mcp__conport__conport_log_progress` -> `mcp__conport__log_progress`; `mcp__conport__conport_save_custom_data` -> `mcp__conport__save_custom_data`; `mcp__conport__conport_search_content` -> `mcp__conport__search_content`; `mcp__conport__conport_update_context` -> `mcp__conport__update_context`; `mcp__conport__conport_update_progress` -> `mcp__conport__update_progress`. The same map applies to bare mentions without the mcp__conport__ prefix.

FTS map: search_decisions_fts and search_custom_data_value_fts -> search_content(workspace_id, query). Drop `limit` (search_content has none) and instruct reading the top N results instead. Where a command already lists get_decisions as an alternative, keep get_decisions(workspace_id, limit).

Live signatures (docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/server.py): get_context: get_context(workspace_id: str) | get_progress: get_progress(workspace_id: str, status: Optional[str]=None, limit: int=20) | log_decision: log_decision(workspace_id: str, topic: str, decision: str, rationale: str, tags: Optional[List[str]]=None) | log_progress: log_progress(workspace_id: str, description: str, status: str='IN_PROGRESS', priority: str='medium', linked_decision_id: Optional[str]=None) | save_custom_data: save_custom_data(workspace_id: str, category: str, key: str, value: Any) | search_content: search_content(workspace_id: str, query: str) | update_context: update_context(workspace_id: str, context_data: dict) | update_progress: update_progress(progress_id: str, updates: dict) | get_decisions: get_decisions(workspace_id: Optional[str]=None, limit: int=10) | get_custom_data: get_custom_data(workspace_id: str, category: Optional[str]=None, key: Optional[str]=None)
Every example call carries workspace_id. Where an example omitted it, add the placeholder `"workspace_id": "<workspace_root>"` (the .claude/claude.md convention). Never invent concrete values.

Argument names in examples must match the signature parameter names (e.g. log_decision uses topic/decision/rationale/tags; log_progress uses description/status/priority/linked_decision_id). If a command's intent cannot be expressed with the live tool, STOP and return evidence (fallback trigger).
Only text in the listed files changes. Model pins (`model:` frontmatter) are NOT touched (W02 owns them).
